newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian metals market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Indian metals market closed for holiday.

text.p: Indian metals markets were closed on Friday for Hindu religious festival holiday.
On Thursday, zinc fell 75 rupees to 7,500 per quintal on demand resistance while nickel lost 100 rupees to 37,100 on renewed selling against sliding global prices, dealers said.

Limited fresh supplies helped copper end steady at 13,350 rupees per quintal as industrial demand remained sluggish. Tin was unchanged at 31,500 rupees per quintal, aluminium at 7,400 and lead at 4,525.
